b-sweet-hash.name: Sweet Potato Hash
steps: Sauté potato in oil until tender.
Add pepper; season with salt and pepper.

b-chia.name: Chia Pudding Cup
steps: Stir chia and milk; chill overnight.

b-tofu-skip.name: Turmeric Lentil Bowl
steps: Sauté kale; stir in lentils and spices.

l-salmon-bowl.name: Salmon Grain Bowl
steps: Flake salmon over quinoa and broccoli.

l-turkey-wrap-alt.name: Turkey Lettuce Cups
steps: Fill lettuce cups with turkey and veggies.

l-tuna-salad.name: Tuna & Avocado Plate
steps: Mix tuna with lemon; serve with avocado.

l-beef-bowl.name: Beef & Veggie Bowl
steps: Stir-fry beef with veggies; serve over rice.

d-salmon-rice.name: Salmon, Rice & Greens
steps: Bake salmon; steam greens; serve with rice.

d-turkey-meatballs.name: Turkey Meatballs & Zoodles
steps: Bake meatballs; warm sauce with zoodles.

d-stir-fry.name: Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Stir-fry chicken and veggies; serve over rice.

d-beef-skillet.name: Beef & Potato Skillet
steps: Sauté beef and veggies until done.

s-apple.name: Apple & Sunflower Butter
steps: Slice apple; dip in seed butter.
